task_instance: Extract the transcript, metadata and chapters of a public YouTube video (the first-ever uploaded clip, a short captioned video) using the bundled scripts/extract_transcript.py and save it as a Markdown file with YAML frontmatter.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable requires yt-dlp to reach the YouTube video-hosting service to download video metadata and VTT subtitles. yt-dlp installed and ran, but every request to YouTube was refused by the environment's outbound agent proxy with a 'Tunnel connection failed: 403 Forbidden' (ProxyError) on all 3 retries, so no metadata or subtitles could be fetched and no transcript Markdown could be produced. yt-dlp has no network-free path to this data.
evidence: Created venv at <work>/.venv and ran 'pip -q install yt-dlp' -> yt-dlp 2026.10.26 installed successfully. Copied the two bundled scripts into <work>/scripts/ (both present next to SKILL.md: extract_transcript.py, deduplicate_transcript.py). Ran 'yt-dlp --dump-json --no-download <a public YouTube watch URL>' which returned only: 'WARNING: [youtube] <urlopen error Tunnel connection failed: 403 Forbidden>. Retrying (1/3)...' through (3/3), then 'Unable to download webpage ... ProxyError ... Tunnel connection failed: 403 Forbidden'. No JSON metadata was emitted. The dependency (yt-dlp) and the skill's scripts are available and functional; the only blocker is that the runtime's proxy forbids connections to the YouTube service, so the deliverable transcript file cannot be created or verified.
